newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telebras 1996 net 2.756 bln reais. [CORRECTED 18:38 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Telebras 1996 net 2.756 bln reais. [CORRECTED 18:38 GMT]

text.p: Brazilian state-owned telecommunications firm Telebras said it had a net consolidated profit of 2.756 billion reais in 1996, while its holding company reported a 3.254 billion reais net profit in the period.
In 1995, Telebras' net consolidated profit was 810 million reais, while its holding's earnings totalled 1.183 billion reais.
Telebras' 1996 results reflected an increase in traffic, a reduction in costs and gains with a tariff rebalancing, it said in a statement.
The company's net operating revenues totalled 12.487 billion reais last year, while its gross operating revenues amounted to 16.478 billion reais.
Telebras' 1996 earnings raised the firm's net profit per 1,000 shares to 10.15 reais from 3.82 reais (corrects from 2.62 reais),
The firm's net worth rose to 27.7 billion reais in 1996, from 24.2 billion reais in the previous year.
Telebras also said it invested 6.7 billion reais in 1996 and plans to invest 7.9 billion reais this year. ((-- Fatima Cristina, Sao Paulo Newsroom, 5511 2485412))
